Lophius piscatorius or angler fish in aquarium of Tromso, Norway.
Anglerfish ( Lophius piscatorius ) is caught by researchers during monitoring cruise in the North Sea onboard German research vessel Walther Herwig III.
Species caught during MEDITS campaigns in the Mediterranean. An emblematic benthic fish, the anglerfish is also known as the monkfish. It is generally found on soft bottoms between 2 and 1000 meters,
